method: Scripted chromium sweep (uat-driver.mjs) with human visual review of captures; scores per specs/references/handoff/_shared/tests/uat-ux-aesthetics.md
observations: uat-observations.json (19 journeys, 48 objective checks, 45 pass; the 3 recorded failures are adjudicated below)

journeys.notes: Fail-closed verified live: dataLayer empty before decision, denial persisted (finspeed-consent=denied), banner absent and analytics silent after reload.
Hero, dominant CTA, ride-type cards; first-time orientation immediate.
Four journeys, product stage, Escape closes.
Tab reaches header controls with visible focus ring.
Filter tabs, editorial features, governed stock photography (mako-shark-27-5-geared poster live).
Bull Shark serves the verified stock poster (bull-shark-29-r01) with identity honesty.
Full seven-stage flow correct with live prices (4,800 -> 5,000) and governed SKU posters; see ISS-3/ISS-4.
Deep-blue request shows amber price qualifier and Request CTA; cart correctly withheld.
All three portal routes redirect to sign-in; verbatim 'Preview only. Credentials are not verified...' notice; no pricing leak. Driver's landmark-scoped text check was the only failure - see ISS-5.
Renders the editorial Visit Finspeed page, not the tested dealer locator - see ISS-1/ISS-2.

Theme persists across navigation; the persisted custom build resolved its exhaustive-matrix dark asset (red-snapper-24-power-rigid-single-blue-carrier) - v3 persistence and deviating-state resolution proven live. Fresh-profile default-state dark evidence: WEB-035 close-out captures.
Complete bicycle, step indicator, clean stacking at 390px.

issues.title: /dealers serves the editorial Visit page; the tested dealer locator is unreachable in production
issues.detail: Locally and in CI, /dealers renders the SCN-004 dealer locator (map, filters, /api/dealers, outage handling, axe coverage). In production the design client router owns the path and renders the Visit Finspeed page. /api/dealers itself responds 200 JSON.
issues.disposition: Follow-up slice: fix production routing so explicit Next routes win (see ISS-2 root cause), then decide the locator's storefront entry point deliberately.

issues.title: Site-wide client-shell delivery: no server-rendered content, single generic title on every route
issues.detail: Every sampled route (/, /blog, /products/bull-shark, /dealers) returns the same ~175-visible-char shell with title 'Finspeed - Ride Beyond Boundaries'; all content is client-rendered. Suspected WEB-022-era Amplify SPA-fallback rewrite serving the shell for all paths, which also causes ISS-1. Predates this release.
issues.disposition: Follow-up slice: audit Amplify rewrite rules (requires aws sso login), restrict fallback to unknown paths so Next SSR/static output serves, restoring per-route titles/meta and the locator route.

issues.title: Review sticky bar partially occludes its price at 1440px
issues.detail: In the review stage the price glyphs sit partially behind the primary CTA in the sticky action bar (build-review-stock-desktop-light.png).

issues.title: Preview shows 'Preparing selected bicycle' through stage transitions on production latency
issues.detail: Between visual states the stage clears to the preparing treatment until the next 1600px poster decodes; on production round-trips this is visible at each capture point.
issues.disposition: Polish backlog: retain the previous poster while the next decodes.

issues.title: Distributor sign-in content is not inside a main landmark
issues.detail: The preview-only notice is visible but sits outside any main region, which is why the scripted landmark-scoped check missed it. Related to the recorded WEB-036 follow-up on distributor table semantics.
issues.disposition: Fold into the existing distributor accessibility follow-up.

summary.releaseView: The live build is production-worthy for the storefront, configurator, distributor gate, and consent contracts - all verified directly in production with zero console errors. The one major finding (ISS-1/ISS-2) is a pre-existing delivery-layer defect, not a regression from the 2026-07-26 releases.
